notes.title: Xoo: Xeno Xafari Update: New Area! New Xenos!
notes.content:
[b]Xoo: Xeno Xafari v1.1 is out with cool new stuff![/b]

Xoo Island now has a brand new area. This area opens up sometime randomly after day 50. It features 10 new screens and 30 new xenos to find!

The area is accessible on already existed saved games, but you will have to wait for it to randomly appear which typically takes 5 days if you are past day 50.

Other features of the update include:
[list]
[*] Appearance of journal pages, e-mails, and skill books has been slightly reduced in order to make the game feel less front-loaded.
[*] Shop prices have increased for better pacing of unlockables.
[*] Numerous small tweaks, typos, and bug fixes
[/list]

Thanks so much for playing! [b]If you like this game, do me a monumental favor and leave a positive review.[/b] It would really help me to get better placement on Steam!
